name: Beef Barbacoa Burrito Bowls

components.name: Beef Barbacoa

ingredients.name: Low-sodium beef broth (¾ cup, instead of dark beer)

steps: Season the beef and brown in batches in a deep heavy pot.
Blend chipotles with stock, vinegar, lime, garlic, cumin, oregano and ground clove.
Pour the sauce over beef, add bay leaves, cover and simmer on low for 3–4 hours or until it shreds very easily. Add water if needed.
Shred beef with two forks, return it to some reduced cooking liquid and mix well.

components.name: Black Beans
steps: Warm drained beans separately; cool promptly.
Portion rice, beans and barbacoa into ten bowls. Add lime, lettuce or fresh salsa only when serving.
This is a long-clock recipe and should be selected only if Sunday scheduling permits it.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Long cook: 3–4 hours simmer (a slow cooker also works).
Freezer: Beef and beans freeze very well; rice requires rapid cooling and freezing.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
